About us

Experience behind the technology.

BL Monitor and Control is a small company with a big-science background. We bring experience from particle accelerator laboratories to monitoring and control challenges in research and industry.

Practical control, built on experience

We develop and integrate Blinky-Lite, an open-source platform for monitoring and controlling equipment. Our aim is to help people see what is happening, respond to problems and access equipment remotely.

Blinky-Lite is released under the MIT License. Customers can use and adapt the code, work with us on integration and support, or choose another approach that suits their needs.

Meet the team

The people behind BL Monitor and Control

Dr. Georg Hulla

CEO

From an ion source at CERN to an idea for better control.

Working with complex scientific equipment taught Georg Hulla a lesson: building the hardware is only part of the challenge. Making it accessible and practical to operate can be just as demanding.

His experience developing a control system for an ion source at CERN helped inspire Blinky-Lite. Together with David McGinnis, he co-founded BL Monitor and Control to bring a more accessible approach to monitoring and control. As CEO, Georg draws on his experience at CERN and the European Spallation Source to help connect technology with real-world needs.

Georg’s LinkedIn profile

Dr. David McGinnis

CTO

Big-science experience, applied to everyday challenges.

David McGinnis has spent much of his career working with machines where precision, reliability and good instrumentation matter. An accelerator physicist, he has held technical and leadership roles at Fermilab and the European Spallation Source, working on radio-frequency systems and accelerator integration.

Today, David works full-time at BL Monitor and Control, bringing that experience to Blinky-Lite. As CTO, he focuses on making sophisticated monitoring and control practical for a wider range of equipment—from research facilities to industrial systems.
